posts.title: Sample post: getting started
posts.excerpt: Demo content so you can verify list/detail UI, relations, and .dkit-prose.
posts.body:
This is sample seed data from the blog module. Delete or rewrite it in Directus once your own content is ready.

What this post exercises

Use it to confirm the public API, featured image, author relation, and rich-text rendering in your app.

Seed posts should look like real editorial HTML — headings, quotes, lists — so layout and .dkit-prose can be judged immediately.

Checklist

  • List view shows title, excerpt, and image
  • Detail view renders this body
  • Author name and avatar resolve
  • Category “Engineering” is attached

Next steps

  1. Edit this item in Directus
  2. Add a second author or category
  3. Point your routes at getPosts / getPostBySlug

Replace every sample field before going to production.

posts.title: Sample post: modeling notes
posts.excerpt: Second demo post — status, publish date, and prose without a featured image.
posts.body:
A second sample item helps you test sorting, cards vs list templates, and empty featured-image fallbacks.

Fields to notice

status gates public reads. published_at is the date shown on the site (auto-filled on create, editable for backdating).

Prose elements

  • Paragraphs and emphasis
  • Inline code
  • Ordered and unordered lists

Keep seed copy neutral and instructional. It ships to every developer who runs --seed, not as project marketing.

Safe to delete after you confirm the install.
